datasets.name: Wenchuan County post-earthquake UAV imagery
datasets.verbatim: This study used data from an SF-300 UAV equipped with a Canon EOS 5D Mark II camera that was flown over Wenchuan County in Sichuan Province, China, on 15 August 2010

datasets.name: MS COCO dataset
datasets.verbatim: The model files for this experiment were pre-trained with the MSCOCO dataset and can be downloaded at this URL https://github.com/facebookresearch/detectron2/blob/main/MODEL_ZOO.md

datasets.name: Haiti post-earthquake GF-2 satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: Haiti post-earthquake GF-2 satellite image from 2021.

methods.name: Improved Mask R-CNN
methods.summary: An instance segmentation model based on Mask R-CNN that utilizes ResNet-50, ResNet-101, or Swin Transformer as backbone networks. It incorporates transfer learning from MS COCO pre-trained weights and data augmentation (rotation and flipping) to improve landslide detection accuracy and generalization.
methods.verbatim: The network structure code used in the article can be downloaded at these two URLs: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection (accessed on 4 July 2022) and https://github.com/SwinTransformer/Swin-Transformer-Object-Detection (accessed on 4 July 2022).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory used for training or validation is not referenced or linked. Only the base structure code is available via the provided repository links.
